shots.detail_en: CH presses one finger onto a defected sell slip at the empty after-hours counter.
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: RED pushes a stack of return slips across the archive room desk toward CH under a single desk lamp.
shots.sub: 我核了一整夜。倒戈单走了三条路——层层托管，起点全是同一批新户头。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: RED's fingertip taps across the three stamps on the slips one by one.
shots.sub: 老一辈管这叫'三层抽屉'——东西从抽屉里过，不留指纹。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: CH leafs through the slips and freezes on one bearing a faint tea-ring stain in the corner.
shots.sub: 纸不会说谎。这张纸——坐过茶局。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: In flashback, hot tea pours into a cup, the steam curling in the light into a spiral like a rising wind.
散户甲 and the brothers gang up around MANCANG at the cha chaan teng table, fists slamming the tabletop.
shots.sub: 跟错人了！满仓，你带的什么路！
shots.speaker: 散户甲

shots.detail_en: 散户乙 jabs a finger at MANCANG's nose while the others crowd in behind him.
shots.speaker: 散户乙

shots.detail_en: MANCANG cradles an untouched bowl of wonton noodles, eyes brimming with tears.
shots.sub: 我满仓，你们也满仓——我们满的，是同一个仓啊……
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: CH sits down across from MANCANG and gently nudges the noodle bowl closer to him.
shots.sub: 先吃面。跌下去的是价，没跌的是兄弟。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Montage of the trail converging — RED re-checking the slips, CH drawing three-layer arrows in the notebook, the wind vane turning outside the window.
shots.sub: 父亲的笔记本教过我：风不会自己转弯。会转弯的，是人手。
shots.speaker: 旁白（长虹）

shots.detail_en: The notebook page shows a hand-drawn wind vane, its arrow looping three circles and ending at a teacup.
Next morning's open — sell slips still drifting through the hall as retail traders huddle under the giant board in dread.
CH walks slowly to the front of the giant board, and the crowd noise falls away as every eye turns to him.
CH speaks into the silence, calm, neither arguing nor angry — one sentence only.
shots.sub: 诸位——风是借来的。借来的东西，迟早要还。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: CH lifts his eyes and adds the last half-sentence in a flat K-line tone.
shots.sub: 影线画得再长——收线的时候，总要回到实体。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: In slow motion the flip-board visibly slows, the drifting slips find no takers and fall to the floor one by one.
散户甲 and 散户乙 trade glances, sell slips crumpling in their fists.
shots.speaker: 散户甲／散户乙

shots.detail_en: The cloth banner at the hall door sags from taut to hanging in one beat — the wind dying on itself.
On the second-floor VIP gallery, XIONG's prayer beads stop for half a beat, then resume as if nothing happened, his smile unchanged.
shots.sub: 借了要还——这道理，是我教他的。
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: RED watches CH's back beneath the giant board from behind the counter.
shots.sub: 那句话不是说给散户听的——是说给风听的。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: Black card with the golden line rising in white text.
shots.sub: 风是借来的。借来的东西——迟早要还。——《第二回合收官》
shots.card: 风是借来的。借来的东西——迟早要还。——《第二回合收官》
